turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My partner and I want to get into longer strategy games for winter, but we've only played easy ones.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm going to list all the options first, so please don't comment until I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A farming game where you grow crops, raise animals and feed your family, about two hours.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A space exploration game with lots of little cards and combos, quite chunky, maybe three hours.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A two player only card game about building a civilisation through the ages, under an hour.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A detective campaign where you solve cases over a dozen evenings, more story than strategy.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If you love stories, the detective campaign is perfect for winter, a case a week. For pure strategy, start with the short civilisation game and move to farming when you want something longer.
